title: Grateful Dead Live at Felt Forum, Madison Square Garden on 1971-12-07

ai_review.summary: Top‑drawer soundboard capture of a high‑energy 12/7/71 Felt Forum show with smoking Smokestack Lightning and stellar Brokedown Palace
ai_review.review: The recording is hailed as one of the best soundboards ever released – crisp, well‑balanced and loud enough to let Jerry’s soaring guitar shine, despite an occasional muddy start and brief right‑channel crackle. Musically the band is on fire: a scorching Smokestack Lightning, gorgeous Brokedown Palace, tight Cold Rain & Snow and a fun Run Rudolph make this one of ’71’s standout nights.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 75% of reviews are five‑star, praising both the performance and the superb soundboard source; only minor technical quibbles appear, so the combined show/recording score is very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix described as crisp, loud and wonderfully balanced. Early moments a bit muddy for some listeners; occasional right‑channel distortion/crackle noted, and occasional over‑saturation, but overall considered one of the finest soundboard releases.

poor_songs: Sugar Magnolia (tuning up at the start)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid, tightly sequenced set that covers the band’s classic ’71 material with smooth transitions and plenty of high‑energy moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his beautiful, loud tone; solo on Brokedown Palace called “melted my soul” and noted as a highlight of the night.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as melodic, tight and often “bombing” with bass; several reviewers mention his enthusiastic playing and strong presence throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Both Keith Godchaux and Pigpen are on keyboards, a treat for fans; Pigpen’s vocals and harp work are highlighted as back‑in‑action highlights.
